definitions.explanation: An expression of strong condemnation, indicating that something is so bad or unacceptable that it is beyond description with words.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ような→ようだ：26593_youda⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言語道断|ごんごどうだん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{公金|こうきん}→公金：29287_koukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言語道断|ごんごどうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Embezzlement of public funds is an unspeakable act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{虐待|ぎゃくたい}→虐待：14046_gyakutai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言語道断|ごんごどうだん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{言語|ごんご} (language, words) + {道断|どうだん} (cutting off the path)

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally a Buddhist term meaning a truth so profound that it cannot be expressed in words. The modern meaning has shifted to describe something so bad it defies description.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a na-adjective with ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ or as a noun:
- {言語道断|ごんごどうだん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (is outrageous)
- {言語道断|ごんごどうだん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (outrageous act)

REGISTER:
Formal. Often used in serious contexts like news reports, official statements, or when expressing strong moral condemnation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{許|ゆる}しがたい→許しがたい：noentry⟧: unforgivable
- ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧: outrageous, absurd
- ⟦{論外|ろんがい}→論外：29289_rongai⟧: out of the question
